value.rationale: Theorem 3.14 is the article's explicit minimal-expansion-coefficient result, a central numerical property of canonical duals. The failure occurs in the smallest possible relay system and can be arbitrarily amplified by changing one positive weight. The correction is not merely a disclaimer: it extracts from the published proof the exact weighted Hilbert geometry in which the intended minimum-norm statement is valid.
